Package dev.opencollab.paletter.item.component

Class Shooter.Ammunition

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.item.component.Shooter.Ammunition
Enclosing class:
Shooter
public static final class Shooter.Ammunition extends Object
A list of ammunition entries that define which items can be used as projectiles for this shooter. Each entry specifies the item, whether to search the offhand, inventory, and whether to use in creative mode.
